panels.caption: Rule editor → condition 1 → field list (top of the list; not saved)
Full field list and operators
panels.flag: SEEN IN THE LIST + FROM THE BUILD'S CODE
text: Fields offered (all 21, read from the open list): Subject, Contact, Account, Status, Priority, Channel, Classification, Due Date, Ticket Owner, Product, Email, Phone, Description, Resolution, Department, Skills, Language, CRM Deal, Contract, Approval Status, Tags.

Ticket fields NOT offered (from GET /modules/{tickets}/fields, 40 fields): Name, Ticket Number, Team, Created Time, Created By, Modified Time, Modified By, Closed Time, Response Due Date, First Response Time, Happiness Rating, Happiness Link Status, Spam, Customer Responded, Pending Review, Archived, Shared Departments, SLA Name, SLA Violated, SLA Escalated.
No CONTACTS or ACCOUNTS group: searching "Contact" returns only the ticket's own Contact lookup.

Operators in the picker (code): text = equals, does not equal, contains, starts with, ends with, is one of, is not one of, empty, changed. Date = on, after, on or after, before, on or before, empty, changed. No "doesn't contain", no "between", no "current time" value — although the engine has NotContains and Between.
